verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms docs.tavily.com/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with agent-oriented content, including CLI usage examples. The docs also serve markdown versions of API reference pages (.md endpoints) and provide an agent-setup SKILL.md with the instruction "Let your coding agent install and configure Tavily for you." Missing for 10: evidence of an llms-full.txt or a complete single-file docs dump, and independent community corroboration of agents successfully consuming these docs.
